systems.system: Public Security Project Phase 2 (integrated public security and anti-crime surveillance system)
systems.owner: Government of Angola / National Police; financed by an Export-Import Bank of China commercial loan of about US$80m committed in 2021
systems.tiers: Phase 1 was the CISP opened in Luanda in December 2019; phase 2 extends CCTV, facial recognition and command-and-control infrastructure to additional cities beyond Luanda

note: A loan record for a surveillance and command-and-control system; nothing on station records.
